gen-gf-mona-sans-fs-literata: Crisp and modern, Mona Sans cuts its terminals back to leave a generous gap. And Literata follows with sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones, a text serif that gives the page a bookish counterweight.
gen-gf-monda-fs-literata: Literata arrives with sturdy hairlines and slightly heavier strokes, its curves wide open. Monda's bowls open like a cupped palm of clay above it, and the weight gap between them is thread against yarn: measured, never jarring, so a long passage moves along smoothly.
gen-gf-mooli-fs-literata: Wide-mouthed and plain-spoken, Mooli leaves a generous slot in its c. It earns its keep big and short, while Literata, a classic serif with mild thick and thin variation, holds the finer work beneath.
gen-gf-murecho-fs-literata: Approachable from the first line, Murecho keeps its counters connected to the space outside. Literata then adds moderate contrast, neither stark nor flat, which is the pair's real strength: a serif with a bookish, sophisticated hush.
gen-gf-nanum-gothic-fs-literata: Tidy and see-through, Nanum Gothic leaves a visible gap in every s and keeps its heading crisp. But Literata, a serif with a gentle gradient along each rounded stroke, lets a long read unfold with unhurried ease.
gen-gf-nanum-myeongjo-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans is sharp and refined, leaving generous space between its curve ends and the stem. And Nanum Myeongjo, literary and mellow in its thick-thin shifts, gives that precision a bookish voice above it.
gen-gf-neuton-fs-bespoke-sans: Neuton sets a dignified, editorial tone with soft contrast. Bespoke Sans then slips in below, sharper and lower in contrast, so the serif's warmth and the sans-serif's precision share the page comfortably.
gen-gf-news-cycle-fs-literata: News Cycle stands its stems close together and keeps a bright gap at every curve's mouth. Literata, a text serif with a gentle swell from stem to serif, is the quality that makes this pairing feel bookish yet fresh.
gen-gf-niramit-fs-literata: Niramit greets you with an open, welcoming gap in its c, modern and friendly from the first word. Literata, a classic serif, adds slightly thinner curves on top of rounded letters and a bookish depth.
gen-gf-noto-sans-canadian-aboriginal-fs-: Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal keeps every small counter unclogged, giving headings a contemporary, uncluttered finish. Literata, a serif with the mild swelling of a worn felt marker, carries a longer stretch with sturdy, bookish ease.
